findings.statement: The Yuanhai 基礎 block uses 以甲為例 / 以乙為例 with 见 stem examples, including 见乙：为比肩、兄弟、朋友. The 論天干地支暗藏總訣 heading begins later on p.4, so this observed block is a stem-example context distinct from the later hidden-stem heading.
The Ditiansui p.4 sentence states 五阳得阳之气，即能成其阳刚 ... 五阴得阴之气，即能成其阴顺 and continues with 势盛/势衰 and 情义 wording before the 甲木 section.
The Ziping p.5 section defines 会 as 三会 and 合 as 六合, then states 三方为会，朋友之意也 and 并对为合，比邻之意也. The passage discusses earthly-branch relation topology and examples.

None of the three source contexts supplies a premise that is simultaneously an explicitly scoped current engine value and a person-level temperament or behavior-style antecedent: the Yuanhai 见 operand is not the current aggregated visible/hidden distribution, Ditiansui 得阳之气/势 is not a current field, and Ziping relation glosses do not state an individual behavior disposition.

claims.statement: The bounded calculation-first scan found no executable classical temperament rule candidate after immediate semantic-bridge exclusion.
A classical temperament rule is ready for admission from this bounded scan.

unknowns.statement: The Yuanhai 见 stem examples do not define whether a current tenGods.visible or tenGods.hidden aggregate is an equivalent operand, and the aggregate loses the source stem/pillar identity.
The Ditiansui terms 得阳之气, 得阴之气, and subsequent 势盛/势衰 are not emitted as current engine fields with a source-defined threshold or scope.
The Ziping 朋友之意 / 比邻之意 wording does not define a person-level temperament or behavior-style rule, and 三会/三方 has no direct one-to-one label in the current branch relation output.
The historical edition, transmission lineage, and independent witness status of all three local exports remain unresolved.
